verdict.rationale: The evidence covers automatic retries and checkpoint resumption during execution (docs-2, docs-15), plus CLI-based inspection of failed runs and their traces (docs-37). None of it documents a user-initiated replay or rerun of an already-failed run from its recorded history, or a rerun starting from a chosen step. Automatic retry and trace inspection are adjacent features, not the replay capability itself.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I replay or rerun a failed workflow from its recorded history — optionally from a specific step — to debug and recover
